proposal.hypothesis: On the supplied GH200/CUDA 12.6.3 target, reusing warpReduceSum for warp 0's final aggregation may let the int specialization use __reduce_add_sync instead of the current two shuffle-down additions. Only the CTA-local final combine changes; the 128-thread geometry, one-value-per-lane load, tail identity, stage schedule, scratch selection, and final copy remain fixed. The controller's complete-run timing must establish whether this instruction-level change helps independently of launch topology.

retained: Replace the two final shuffle-down additions with a full-warp warpReduceSum call over the four warp totals and zero-valued remaining lanes.
Keep the launch geometry, per-lane input load, tail handling, scratch schedule and final copy unchanged.
